evidence: Wording is taken from the deposit's own label file, keyed mv.MCQ.F1-F4 against response columns it.MCQ.F1-F4 -- same instrument, facet and number, differing only in the rater-frame prefix. That substitution is the table's one inference and route 6 tests it: the label file makes itmcqf3 the facet's only reverse-worded item, and in the live data it is the only item with a negative mean correlation against the rest, -0.420 (pairwise -0.385, -0.457, -0.417) against +0.253, +0.240 and +0.257 for the other three, which intercorrelate +0.566 to +0.611. So the polarity class of all four items reproduces and the reverse-worded item is identified outright. What this does NOT do is separate itmcqf1, itmcqf2 and itmcqf4 from one another; no per-item statistics are available to do that, the article being paywalled, hence PARTIAL. validate_items.R reports item and resp sets matching live data (4 items, 2,028 rows).
